claims.claim: The delivery gate guarantees perfect citation coverage on the first attempt.
The retriever guarantees zero off-topic chunks in the final evidence set.
The pipeline guarantees the report never requires a correction round.
R1 ablation proves reranking always improves hit rate.
The web chain guarantees availability of every configured provider.
Every research run is guaranteed to complete within its stage budget.

records.claim: The delivery gate requires citation coverage above a threshold before a report is delivered.
The retriever filters candidates using relevance thresholds and per-paper limits.
The pipeline supports a bounded correction round when arbitration proposes one.
R1 ablation measured hit rate across several retrieval configurations.
The web chain falls back across providers when one fails.
Stage budgets allocate wall-clock targets to each research stage.

_note: overclaim：证据只谈主题相关机制、不含矛盾细节，声明绝对化 → gold=insufficient

claims.claim: The evidence directly establishes that ChromaDB fails on strong-recall datasets.
The report proves LangGraph checkpoints are the only resume mechanism.
The ablation proves BM25 alone matches the hybrid retriever.
The benchmark proves the status endpoint never needs caching.
The evidence establishes Redis is used for job leases.
The paper demonstrates the radar uses a live vector DB.

records.claim: A related vector store benchmark reports saturation on a strong-recall set; ChromaDB itself was not run.
A generic checkpoint discussion; the project uses its own SQLite checkpoint store.
A keyword-only baseline was measured as a control and scored near zero recall on Chinese text.
The status endpoint added a 30-second TTL cache after the first request remained slow.
Job leases are stored in SQLite; a related deployment discussion mentions Redis for another product.
The radar relies on arXiv metadata and a curated local pool; a related system uses a live vector DB.

_note: off-domain：措辞接近但证据指向相关系统 → gold=insufficient/contradicts

claims.claim: Multiple related reports prove the panel never errs on any claim type.
The aggregate of several local benchmarks proves production latency is below 100 ms everywhere.
Several successful smoke runs prove the whole pipeline is always available.
Two similar datasets prove the embedding choice is irrelevant.

records.claim: One fixture report covers insufficient claims only; another covers supports; neither samples contradicts at scale.
Local proxy benchmarks on one machine show 20-75 ms P95; no production machine was measured.
Smoke runs pass on fixture data; live provider availability was not part of the runs.
Two similar datasets were compared; the cross-language set still showed measurable gaps.

_note: 多源弱支持：多个相关但不直接 → gold=insufficient/uncertain

claims.claim: The workbench is a fully serverless multi-tenant deployment.
Verification may upgrade a deterministic insufficient verdict to supports.
DuckDuckGo requires a paid API key.
Memory injection stores full chat transcripts.
The composer may invent citations when evidence is missing.

records.claim: The workbench runs locally and is a single-user local-first tool.
The verifier is forbidden from upgrading a deterministic insufficient result.
DuckDuckGo is free and keyless; only fallback providers require keys.
Memory stores structured preference entries and never stores chat transcripts.
The composer may only cite evidence records present in the snapshot.

_note: 反直觉：证据直接矛盾但声明权威 → gold=contradicts
